summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Order Placement & Confirmation screens (Iteration 14). Backend: 10/10 API tests passed (7 workflow tests verified manually via curl). Frontend: All new features working correctly including admin new orders panel, public tracking page, order success failed state.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin order endpoints properly protected with require_admin() middleware - returns 401 without auth
GET /api/admin/orders/new returns {orders, count, server_time} structure correctly
?since=<future ISO date> parameter correctly filters to empty list
Non-existent order on accept/reject/advance returns 404 as expected
Public GET /api/orders/{id} works without auth (order_id acts as link token)
Accept endpoint sets status='preparing' and records accepted_at timestamp
Reject endpoint sets status='rejected', rejection_reason, and rejected_at
Advance endpoint correctly cycles: delivery pending→preparing→ready→out_for_delivery→delivered; pickup/dine_in pending→preparing→ready→completed
AdminNewOrdersPanel polls every 6s, shows order cards with Accept/Reject/View buttons
Mute toggle persists state in localStorage (admin_muted key)
Empty state 'You're all caught up' displays when no paid orders
Red pulsing count badge (new-orders-count) shows number of incoming orders
OrderTrackingPage shows stepper with correct step highlighted based on status
Rejected order shows tracking-rejected banner with rejection reason
OrderSuccessPage failed state shows reason label and back-to-menu-btn
seed_data_creation: Test orders created via mongosh for manual verification, cleaned up after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 Order Placement & Confirmation fully tested. Key features verified: (1) Backend: GET /api/admin/orders/new (auth required, returns {orders, count, server_time}, ?since filter works), POST /accept (sets status='preparing', accepted_at), POST /reject (sets status='rejected', rejection_reason), POST /advance (delivery: pending→preparing→ready→out_for_delivery→delivered; pickup/dine_in: pending→preparing→ready→completed), GET /api/orders/{id} (public, no auth). (2) Frontend Admin: AdminNewOrdersPanel with 6s polling, order cards with Accept/Reject/View buttons, mute toggle persisted in localStorage, empty state 'You're all caught up', red pulsing count badge. (3) Frontend Tracking: OrderTrackingPage with stepper, countdown timer, itemized list, delivery/pickup address, totals, rejected banner, error state for non-existent orders. (4) Frontend Success: OrderSuccessPage with email preview toggle (email-preview-section, email-preview-toggle, email-preview-content), failed state with reason label and back-to-menu-btn. MOCKED: Email is visual preview only (not actually sent). Audio chime generated via Web Audio API (no external file).
